summary: After any review reject resets all shards to in_progress, re-gate the policy shards (verify_tooling, autoloop_meta) FIRST. Trusted tooling overlays apply only from shards in status passed; gating product shards earlier silently falls back to base fast_check and produces spurious guardrail failures (e.g. oracle-registry on invoice_batches.py). check should order policy shards first or refuse while a policy shard is not passed.
